args.CodeContent:
# Header & Footer Theme Upgrade: Clean White & Frosted Glass

The **Header** and **Footer** have been transitioned from the previous dark theme (`#111827`) to a **Clean White & Frosted Glass Luxury Theme** with an adaptive logo format:

---

## 1. Adaptive Logo for Light Themes ([logo-dark.webp](file:///c:/xampp/htdocs/Farmlelo/assets/images/logo-dark.webp))
- The original `logo.webp` contained white text (`LELO`) and white house outlines that would disappear on a light background.
- Generated `assets/images/logo-dark.webp` where:
  - **"FARM"**, the palm trees, birds, windows, and wave remain vibrant **Cyan** (`#00AEEE` / `#16A5DE`).
  - **"LELO"** and the rooflines are rendered in **Dark Slate** (`#0F172A`).
- The logo is crystal-clear, sharp, and high-contrast on light backgrounds.

---

## 2. Header Redesign ([header.php](file:///c:/xampp/htdocs/Farmlelo/app/Views/Includes/header.php))
- **Frosted Glass Container**: `bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-200 shadow-xs`.
- **Navigation Links**: Bold text in dark slate (`#334155`), with subtle hover highlight `color: #16a5de; background: rgba(22, 165, 222, 0.08);`.
- **Search Bar**: Pill search bar with light `#f1f5f9` fill, `#e2e8f0` border, and cyan focus ring.
- **Action Buttons & Profile**: 
  - `+ List Your Farm`: Cyan pill border with hover fill.
  - Profile Name: Dark slate text with hover transition.
  - Mobile Search & Hamburger Menu: Clean light slate buttons (`#f1f5f9`).

---

## 3. Footer Redesign ([footer.php](file:///c:/xampp/htdocs/Farmlelo/app/Views/Includes/footer.php))
- **Background & Structure**: Soft off-white / light slate (`#f8fafc`) with a 1px top border (`#e2e8f0`) and the top cyan gradient accent bar.
- **Brand Column**: Uses `logo-dark.webp` with `FarmLelo` branding, soft slate description, and contact info in dark slate (`#334155`) with cyan icons.
- **Social Media Icons**: Clean white circular pill buttons with subtle borders and brand hover colors (Facebook blue, Instagram gradient, WhatsApp green).
- **Navigation Columns**: Dark slate headers (`#0f172a`), muted link text (`#64748b`) with hover effects.
- **Startup India Badge & Copyright**: Refined light card design.

---

## 4. Mobile Navigation Drawer ([style.css](file:///c:/xampp/htdocs/Farmlelo/assets/css/style.css))
- Upgraded the mobile drawer to a clean white theme (`#ffffff`), dark slate menu items (`#334155`), and subtle dividers.

---
